summary: Live checkpoint: job 9742743 is RUN with 133 completed steps per internal image and no force-converged image. Create the user-requested hourly follow-up to review completion and propose Sella seed/budget only after a passed path review.

payload.objective: Monitor formal 80-core local VASP ordinary micro-NEB job 9742743 and validate its completed path before selecting any TS refinement method.
current_evidence: At the 2026-09-05 checkpoint, live bjobs -w 9742743 reported RUN in Gkn_normal. The compact NEB monitor at 15:53 CST reported 133 completed steps for each of five internal images, normal electronic iterations, and maximum NEB force 0.161991 eV/A; none of the images was force-converged. Geometry and scientific validity were not reassessed at this checkpoint.
The formal bundle contains seven images with five internal images and uses 80 MPI ranks, NSW=300, LCLIMB=false, ENCUT=400 eV, and SIGMA=0.20 eV.
The submission preflight passed with bundle sha256 4485d88f4de07d52c9a4e0537f0959d7ebc473735226bbadc5b8a0be6a8b32c0.
The execution gate decision was READY_FOR_ORDINARY_NEB_SUBMISSION and explicitly allowed SUBMIT_VASP.
Remote numbered POSCAR inputs 00-06 and POTCAR were verified present after submission.
By explicit user decision, missing neb_pilot_result.json no longer blocks future ordinary-NEB preflight; a supplied pilot result remains subject to full canonical validation.

Local smoke runner syntax and scoped Ruff passed; 7 budget/authorization tests passed. On MZ73, Sella 2.5.0 with the exact current MatRIS epoch-6 checkpoint ran 3 steps and 12 evaluations in 2.646 seconds on one existing 50-atom structure.

The epoch-6 checkpoint and existing five-internal-image inputs are recaptured under the updated software/policy hashes; an optional MatRIS NEB/Sella proposal is saved in outputs/ts_sella_integration_20260905/strategy_proposal.json. Historical baseline, BA-Sella reference and failures remain immutable. No proposal was executed.

Job 1509 producer exit code was 0 and all four returned structures passed work-side hash, fixed-atom, cell and geometry checks. Predicted fmax decreased from 1.508 to 1.285 eV/A but optimization did not converge within the 3-step budget. The scheduler queue was empty after return; terminal accounting is unavailable, so no scheduler DONE claim is made.

Hourly thread follow-up vasp-sella is active. It remains quiet during normal unchanged progress, reviews the completed/stopped path, and proposes formal Sella initial geometry and bounded budget only after the path passes. No new search or training is authorized by this follow-up.
payload.one_executable_step: Follow job 9742743 hourly; after completion or stopping, collect outputs, run canonical completed-path review, and only after a passed review propose a concrete Sella seed and budget without submitting.
payload.submission_boundary: The authorization for job 9742743 is consumed. Do not retry, rebuild, start CI-NEB/Dimer, accept a TS, or report a barrier without new user authority and a current hash-bound gate.
done_when: Job 9742743 reaches DONE or EXIT and final outputs are collected.
Electronic, ionic-force, geometry-continuity, and scientific path-validity checks are reported separately.
A next TS-refinement action is selected only after completed-path evidence is available.
